input_records.source: spark-outputs.csv and the nested record inputs
input_records.note: Spark reads the J09 export and ER assignments; input records per table are in the run manifest inputs, records out per table here

output_records.note: records and invalid records per output table

task_counts.note: tasks, stages and maxTasksPerStage per stage group (StageMetricsListener)

duration.source: emr-steps.csv, sfn-events.csv, the nested record start and end
duration.note: step start and end; execution events

shuffle.note: shuffleReadBytes, shuffleWriteBytes, shuffleReadRecords, shuffleWriteRecords per stage group

failures.source: nested record status, emr-steps.csv (state, failure_reported), sfn-events.csv

estimated_cost.note: estimate (unverified): instance-seconds from the instance lifecycle x $0.240 per instance-hour (COSTS.md:39, m5.xlarge EC2 + EMR); EBS not included

requested_running_capacity.note: checked at analysis; empty series stay missing

released_capacity.source: metrics (drop of CoreNodesRunning before the cluster end) or emr-instances.csv ended_epoch and emr-cluster.json endedEpoch
released_capacity.note: a release at cluster termination is a lifecycle record, not a measured zero and not a scale-in event
